subject: Skyline AI — request for combined credits and rate exception
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@skyline.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@skyline.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick sync — pilot usage & next steps

Samir —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap from my side: the team has been testing the 30-day pilot for the last three weeks, and we see consistent model latency within the profile you wanted (p95 ~220ms). The engineers ran a short eval set and noted a couple of prompt-formatting adjustments; I attached the pilot usage report.

You mentioned procurement would likely want both: (1) some additional trial credits to stretch the evaluation to the full month and (2) a brief rate concession to make the initial committed package align with your budget. I offered to get back with a formal proposal and to check whether we can combine credits + a short-term rate exception to bridge procurement to an initial commit.

Can you confirm a target ARR or committed spend that would make a 6–12 month ramp plausible? That will help me structure the proposal.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: pilot-usage-report.csv
From: Samir Khan <samir@skyline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@skyline.ai>, procurement@skyline.ai
Date: 2027-05-17T14:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — pilot usage & next steps

Ben —

Appreciate the summary. We want to run the pilot for another 30 days to validate two production flows (ingest and batch scoring). Procurement is asking for visibility on economics up front: specifically whether Redwood can provide $12k in additional trial credits and a temporary rate reduction on embed/gen traffic for the first three months of a committed contract.

If Redwood can do $12k credits + a 20% rate exception for the first 90 days (we'd move to the standard rate afterward), we can commit to a $60k initial contract (6 months) with an option to scale. We understand exceptions are reviewed case-by-case — if you need a formal ask to leadership, please route it and copy our procurement alias.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Product, Skyline AI
samir@skyline.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Skyline credits + temporary rate concession — approval request

Rachel —

Looping you in for an exec signoff. Skyline asked for $12k additional trial credits plus a 20% rate exception for 90 days. In return they’re willing to sign a 6-month, $60k committed contract (note: their procurement wants the concession packaged into the initial quote).

Why I’m asking: closing this is high velocity — engineering is happy with perf, and they’re a strategic reference target in the adtech vertical. Risk: marginally lower unit rev for three months, offset by $60k committed ARR and likely expansion. Proposed approval ask below:
- Grant $12,000 in promotional credits applied to the pilot (non-refundable, expires 45 days after issuance).
- Approve a 20% rate exception on gen/embed traffic for the first 90 days after contract signature; rates revert to list after the period.
- Condition: requires signing a minimum 6-month commitment at $60k and inclusion of the exception language in the quote + SOW.

Attachments: Skyline_Quote_v3.pdf (draft with exception language), Skyline_MAP_v2.xlsx (mutual action plan).

Can you approve or point to tweaks? If you prefer, I can escalate to leadership for formal exception.

—Ben
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Skyline AI — request for combined credits & temporary rate exception (summary)

Vivek —

TL;DR: Ben requests approval to offer Skyline $12k in pilot credits + 20% rate concession for 90 days in exchange for a signed 6-month, $60k commit. User acceptance and perf look good — we get a reference in adtech and a short-term ARR win.

Key points I evaluated:
- Upside: $60k committed revenue, strong reference potential, low operational risk.
- Downside: ~20% margin reduction on the first 90 days of usage; credits are promotional and recoverable only through contract.
- Controls: credits to be time-limited and applied only to the pilot invoice; the quote must explicitly state the concession term and an auto-reversion to list pricing. Finance should be notified to track promotional usage against the deal.

My ask: approve up to $12k credits and a 20% temporary rate exception conditional on the signed backing (6-month $60k). If you’re comfortable, please reply with approval language I can forward to Ben to close.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Commercial Operations
Rachel_kim@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skyline AI — request for combined credits & temporary rate exception (summary)

Thanks for the summary. Approve with conditions below:

1) Approve promotional credits: $12,000 applied to pilot usage only. Credits expire 45 days after issuance and do not roll forward.
2) Approve temporary rate exception: 20% off list for gen/embed traffic for 90 days post-signature.
3) Mandatory: Include a minimum 6-month commitment at $60k in the quote; treatment of credits and exception spelled out in quote and SOW.
4) Finance & Legal: Ben, please route the final quote to finance@redwood.com for promotion tracking and to legal for a brief clause about price reversion; cc me. Finance to tag the deal for promo reconciliation.

Ben — proceed to update the quote and send to Skyline with DocuSign. Copy procurement and procurement@skyline.ai.

—Vivek
Co-founder & CEO, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@skyline.ai>, procurement@skyline.ai
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Skyline — confirmed: pilot credits + temporary rate concession (quote attached)

Samir / procurement —

Thanks for the patience. Per leadership approval, Redwood will provide:
- $12,000 in pilot credits (applied to pilot usage; expires 45 days after issuance).
- A temporary 20% rate concession on gen/embed traffic for the first 90 days post-signature.

This is conditioned on Skyline signing the attached 6-month commitment for $60k. The quote (attached) includes the promo language and the reversion clause back to list pricing after 90 days. Please review and return signed via DocuSign: https://docsend.com/view/skyline-quote-v3

Next steps:
- I’ll route the finalized quote to finance@redwood.com for promo tagging and to legal for the final clause.
- Once we have signature, we’ll issue credits and enable the concession in billing.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Skyline_Quote_v3.pdf, Skyline_MAP_v2.xlsx
